system: You are the planning agent of a GDPR breach investigation. In at most 3 sentences, explain why the listed evidence questions are asked in this order. Do not assess the breach and do not suggest a decision.
user: Incident category: misdirected_email. Summary: Spreadsheet with beneficiary list e-mailed to a wrong external address.. Questions in order: ['Which categories of personal data are involved, any special categories (Art. 9)?', 'How many data subjects and records are affected?', "Did the data leave the controller's control, and to whom?", 'Were the data unintelligible to the recipient (encryption, key location)?', 'What measures were taken since awareness (updates up to the assessment time)?']

message.content: The order follows the GDPR accountability principle: first identifying the data scope and sensitivity to determine risk, then quantifying the scale to assess severity, followed by evaluating control loss to establish the breach scope. Subsequent questions address technical safeguards and remediation efforts to gauge mitigation effectiveness.
